name: @pipeworx/mcp-dockerhub

tools.name: search_images
tools.description: Search Docker Hub for container images by keyword. Returns repository name, description, pull count, star count, and official status. Use when finding images for deployment.

limit.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 100)

tools.name: get_image
tools.description: Get detailed metadata for a Docker Hub repository: description, pull count, stars, last updated date, and official status. Use before pulling an image to verify quality and currency.

namespace.description: Repository namespace — use "library" for official images (e.g., "library", "bitnami")

tools.name: get_tags
tools.description: List available tags for a Docker image sorted by recency. Returns tag name, digest, size, and push date. Use to find and select specific versions to pull.

limit.description: Number of tags to return (default 20, max 100)

tools.name: get_tag_details
tools.description: Get full details for a SPECIFIC image tag, including every platform/architecture it supports (os/arch/variant), per-platform digests and sizes, the multi-arch manifest digest, and push date. PREFER for "does <image>:<tag> have an arm64 build", "what platforms does <image>:<tag> support", "the digest/size of <image>:<tag>", multi-arch verification.

namespace.description: Repository namespace (use "library" for official images, e.g. "library", "bitnami").

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-dockerhub forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the dockerhub pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
